subject: [PATCH v5 04/15] SUNRPC: bound the local rpcbind client timeout to 1s

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch limits the timeout for local rpcbind client connections to 1 second. The current default timeouts of 10 seconds for AF_LOCAL and 60 seconds for loopback TCP fallback can cause stalls in NFS server operations, leading to hung-task watchdog warnings. By setting a shorter timeout, the patch reduces the duration of these stalls, but does not eliminate them entirely. A more comprehensive solution would be to make the registration process asynchronous.
